column1: # T17: resolutions of the MAIN name conflicts between names_main.tsv and names_main.T10{a..h}.tsv
# Rule: the sub-task that owns the subsystem page wins (T10b display link/SCI1/keys, T10c SDR link, T10d DSP link,
# T10e EEPROM, T10f menu, T10g radio control, T10h TX/peripherals/timers/GPIO); T10a overview names lose to the owner.

column3: T10d owner (SCI4 = DSP link); loser r_sci4_callback_receiveend (T10b)
T10e (most specific: re-validates QMB recall state); losers startup_state_init (T10a), ui_link_init (T10b)
T10e: the function notifies DISPLAY (0x7F frame), saves and resets, so the T10e name covers it; loser displink_tx_7F_power (T10b)
T10d owner (device 4 = IFDSP register file); loser dev4_reg_access (T05/T09 base)
T10g (value chosen by frequency range, used in radio-control.md); loser dsp_set_band_cal (T10d, not used in any page)
T10c owner (register-numbered updater family); loser sdr_set_tx_freq (T10g)
T10e owner; losers eeprom_save_state (T10a), menu_save_eeprom (T10f), eeprom_save_vfo_block (T10g)
T10f owner (menu value block); loser defaults_menu (T10e)
T10h: setting 0x9AB7 is the TUN/LIN PORT SELECT menu (0 EXT-TUNER, 1 LINEAR, 2 CAT-3, 3 GPO); loser sci2_port_mode (T10b)
T10h owner; losers sw_timer_start (T10a), soft_timer_start (T10b), timer_start_ms (T10d), timer_start (T10e)
T10h owner; losers sw_timer_expired (T10a), soft_timer_expired (T10b), timer_expired (T10d, T10e)
T17: T10d proposed sum8, which duplicates sum8 @ 0xFFFB01AF (EEPROM); renamed to keep names unique
